user.title: Choose authentication method
user.description: The in-fridge camera feed requires a Samsung Account login because the view-inside endpoint is a Samsung-proprietary (not public SmartThings) API. Use 'Samsung Account' for the camera; use SmartThings OAuth or a PAT if you only need generic data (doors, temps, ice maker — which HA core's SmartThings integration also provides).

menu_options.oauth: Reuse HA core SmartThings OAuth — generic data, no password

samsung_account.title: Samsung Account login
samsung_account.description: Sign in with your Samsung Account email + password. The integration will re-login automatically on every 401 — no manual refresh. Note: accounts with 2FA/MFA enabled are not supported by the underlying library. The signin_client_id and signin_client_secret come from the SmartThings Android app (see the README for extraction steps).

oauth.title: Reuse SmartThings OAuth credentials
oauth.description: Select an existing HA core SmartThings integration to borrow its OAuth2 credentials. Tokens refresh automatically. This does NOT enable the camera feed — only generic SmartThings data.

pat.title: SmartThings Personal Access Token
pat.description: Tokens created after 2024-12-30 expire every 24 hours. You will need to reauthenticate after each expiry. Does NOT enable the camera feed.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate SmartThings
reauth_confirm.description: Your SmartThings token has expired. Please enter a new token from https://account.smartthings.com/tokens
